'''Wexlann Tarn''' was an unusual [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], in that his motivations for entering the profession were very different from most. Like many hunters, Tarn was in it for the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]]&mdash;what was unusual was his purpose for seeking this money. Tarn was a connoisseur of fine art and collectibles, and took [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] as a way of financing his personal art collection. Although he had a family fortune which he could have used to purchase his art, Tarn preferred to work as a bounty hunter to "earn" his prized possessions.
